---
name: design-review
description: Independently assess architecture against requirements, repository conventions, and operational risks before implementation.
---

# Design Review

1. Read the approved requirements, architecture, and relevant source files.
2. Review requirement coverage, stack fit, API compatibility, error handling, testing, security, and operational risks.
3. Record evidence-backed findings using `BLOCKER`, `MAJOR`, or `MINOR`.
4. Propose uniquely identified design decisions and link them to findings.
5. Any BLOCKER requires a changes-required verdict.
6. Do not edit the architecture or production code; record user decisions separately.
